description: Weak, partial fit. Mostly fires when I (side to move) have two stones on the long down-right diagonal (4,0)-(3,1)-(2,2)-(1,3)-(0,4) with an empty cell between them and no opponent stone in that 4-cell stretch (typically my stones at (1,3) and (3,1) with column 2 low). In openings, fires when my bottom-row stones sit on both sides of an empty center column. Strongly depends on move order; many matching boards do not fire.
effect: Usually small (<0.15). When strong, it raises the move that adds a third stone to that diagonal (e.g. +0.23 on column 0 when (4,0) is the landing cell; column 4 when (0,4) is), at the expense of other candidates.
notes: 6 score calls. Best F1 0.211 (P 0.17, R 0.27, AUROC 0.62), sim share 0.07 (p4). Broader diagonal rules raise recall but precision falls to 0.05-0.10. Restricting to the (4,0)-(0,4) line is essential (all down-right diagonals: F1 0.08). Minimal pairs: removing either stone of the (1,3)/(3,1) pair kills firing; an O on (0,4) or (0,2) weakens it. But near-identical boards differ widely, and the same board reached in a different move order differs by up to 2 units. Could be a mixture or a random direction.
